profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Intuit Developer
profile.summary:
MS in Software Engineering From San Jose State University

•	Software Engineer providing 2 years of work experience with strong problem solving capability.
•	Experience working on Business Intelligence System.
•	Strong knowledge of Data Mining concepts.
•	Experience working on MySQL database and query concepts.
•	Good Knowledge of Web application development using JAVA, J2EE Technologies
•	Understanding of Machine Learning algorithms such as Clustering and Classification techniques.
•	Understanding of Operating system concepts and networking protocols. 
•	Ability to analyze the code and providing efficient solutions.

Work experience at Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. in the area of Web Development and Business Intelligence System. 

Programming Language : - JAVA, C, Objective C
Database Technologies : - MySQL, Oracle
Business Intelligence Technologies	: - SAP BI, Informatica Powercenter
Cloud Technologies : - IBM Bluemix, Amazon EC2
Web Technologies : - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular JavaScript
Framework : - Spring MVC
JAVA Technologies : - JSP, Servlet, JDBC
Application Servers : - Apache Tomcat
Version Control Tools : - SVN, Git

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on Single Page Application Development for Identity application which serves as a single entry point (Single Sign On) for different types of users of Financial Engines.
•	Implemented highly responsive User Interface using Angular JavaScript 2.0, bootstrap CSS, Jasmine Testing Framework, Karma test runner, webpack and GitLab.
•	Worked on implementation of User Authentication module for SSO using Spring MVC, JAVA, Dynamo DB, Okta API (Identity management).

positions.title: ASE(Assistant System Engineer)
positions.description:
•	Developed JAVA Web applications for Taxation domain using Spring MVC, JSP, Servlet, JavaScript, JDBC and Oracle. 
•	Developed User interface and Client Side Validation using HTML, CSS and JavaScript for Java Web application.
•	Built Business Intelligence system for retail store case study on its data warehouse using Informatica Powercenter.
•	Mentored team of three people and help them understand existing project and client requirements.
•	Designed dashboards and reports using Business Object tool which help top management with decision making in the areas such as finance, HR and material management. 
•	Worked on several types of projects like Support, Implementation, Upgrade and enhancement with domestic as well as International clients.

educations.degreeName: Master of Science (M.S.) in Software Engineering

projects.title: Yelp Application Prototype(Android Application)
projects.description: Developed an android application which provides suggestions for nearby restaurant based on user’s current location.Implemented using Yelp API to fetch the restaurant data and other parameters with SqlLite for data persistence.

projects.title: Generic View Stamped Replication analogous to RAFT
projects.description:
Implemented a fault tolerant distributed system having behavior analogous to RAFT Consensus algorithm.
Developed two modules which includes Leader election and Log replication using Golang.

publications.title: Fortune, Albeit Digital, at the Bottom of the Pyramid - Big Data Powered Business Model for Internet Service Providers(Link)
